Let me look at the option parsing code to understand how option values are extracted:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=thought>
Let me look at how coap_opt_value and coap_opt_length work, and how the PDU is parsed. The key insight is that the Proxy-Uri option value is passed to coap_split_proxy_uri. If the option value pointer/length is inconsistent, the split function could read out of bounds.
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
